description: This file declares structures, constants, and functions related to commit objects in a version control system, likely Git. It includes commit structure definitions, external references, and function prototypes for commit object management, parsing, signatures, and history traversal.

classes.name: commit
classes.description: Represents a commit object containing metadata such as parent commits, timestamps, and associated tree.

classes.name: commit_list
classes.description: A linked list node for handling multiple commits.

classes.name: name_decoration
classes.description: Decorations or labels attached to commits, such as refs and tags.

classes.name: commit_graft
classes.description: Represents grafting information to modify commit history.

classes.name: commit_extra_header
classes.description: Stores additional headers associated with a commit, such as merge tags.

classes.name: commit_stack
classes.description: A stack structure for managing commit objects during traversal or processing.

methods.name: add_name_decoration
methods.description: Associates a label with a commit object for decoration purposes.

methods.name: get_name_decoration
methods.description: Retrieves decorations associated with a commit object.

methods.name: lookup_commit_object
methods.description: Finds a commit object in the repository by its object ID.

methods.name: lookup_commit
methods.description: Finds a commit in the repository by its object ID without replacement.

methods.name: lookup_commit_reference
methods.description: Looks up a commit by object ID, considering replacements.

methods.name: lookup_commit_reference_gently
methods.description: Gently looks up a commit by object ID, possibly returning NULL if not found.

methods.name: lookup_commit_reference_by_name
methods.description: Finds a commit by its name or reference.

methods.name: lookup_commit_reference_by_name_gently
methods.description: Gently looks up a commit by name, returning NULL if not found.

methods.name: lookup_commit_or_die
methods.description: Finds a commit by object ID or terminates if not found.

methods.name: parse_commit_buffer
methods.description: Parses raw commit data from a buffer.

methods.name: repo_parse_commit_internal
methods.description: Internal function to parse commit data within a repository.

methods.name: repo_parse_commit_gently
methods.description: Gently parse commit data, reporting errors without dying.

methods.name: int repo_parse_commit(struct repository * r,struct commit * item)
methods.description: Parse commit data with default options.

methods.name: unparse_commit
methods.description: Serializes a commit object back into a buffer.

methods.name: allocate_commit_buffer_slab
methods.description: Allocates memory buffer slabs for commits.

methods.name: free_commit_buffer_slab
methods.description: Frees memory slabs allocated for commits.

methods.name: set_commit_buffer
methods.description: Associates a raw buffer with a commit.

methods.name: get_cached_commit_buffer
methods.description: Retrieves cached buffer associated with a commit.

methods.name: repo_get_commit_buffer
methods.description: Gets the buffer content of a commit, reading from disk if necessary.

methods.name: repo_unuse_commit_buffer
methods.description: Releases the reference to a commit's buffer.

methods.name: free_commit_buffer
methods.description: Frees cached commit buffers.

methods.name: repo_get_commit_tree
methods.description: Retrieves the tree associated with a commit.

methods.name: get_commit_tree_oid
methods.description: Gets the object ID of the commit's tree.

methods.name: release_commit_memory
methods.description: Releases memory associated with a commit.

methods.name: detach_commit_buffer
methods.description: Disassociates and returns the commit's buffer.

methods.name: find_commit_subject
methods.description: Finds the subject line in a commit message buffer.

methods.name: commit_subject_length
methods.description: Returns the length of the commit subject.

methods.name: commit_list_insert
methods.description: Inserts a commit into a commit list.

methods.name: commit_list_contains
methods.description: Checks if a commit is in a list.

methods.name: commit_list_append
methods.description: Appends a commit to a list.

methods.name: commit_list_count
methods.description: Counts commits in a list.

methods.name: commit_list_insert_by_date
methods.description: Inserts commits into a list ordered by date.

methods.name: commit_list_sort_by_date
methods.description: Sorts a commit list by commit date.

methods.name: copy_commit_list
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of a commit list.

methods.name: reverse_commit_list
methods.description: Reverses a commit list in place.

methods.name: free_commit_list
methods.description: Frees a commit list.

methods.name: repo_logmsg_reencode
methods.description: Reencodes commit log messages into a different encoding.

methods.name: skip_blank_lines
methods.description: Skips blank lines in a message buffer.

methods.name: pop_most_recent_commit
methods.description: Removes and returns the most recent commit from a priority queue.

methods.name: pop_commit
methods.description: Pops a commit from a stack.

methods.name: clear_commit_marks
methods.description: Clears a specific mark from a commit.

methods.name: clear_commit_marks_many
methods.description: Clears a mark from multiple commits.

methods.name: sort_in_topological_order
methods.description: Sorts commits in topological order respecting parent relationships.

methods.name: read_graft_line

methods.name: commit_graft_pos
methods.description: Finds graft position for a given commit OID.

methods.name: register_commit_graft
methods.description: Registers a commit graft in the repository.

methods.name: prepare_commit_graft
methods.description: Prepares grafts for commits.

methods.name: lookup_commit_graft
methods.description: Looks up graft info for a commit.

methods.name: get_fork_point
methods.description: Finds the fork point for a commit from a reference.

methods.name: for_each_commit_graft
methods.description: Iterates over all commit grafts.

methods.name: interactive_add
methods.description: Adds files interactively to the repository.

methods.name: commit_tree

methods.name: commit_tree_extended

methods.name: read_commit_extra_headers
methods.description: Reads extra headers associated with a commit.

methods.name: free_commit_extra_headers
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for commit extra headers.

methods.name: find_commit_header
methods.description: Finds a specific header in commit message.

methods.name: ignored_log_message_bytes
methods.description: Calculates how many bytes to ignore from end of log message.

methods.name: for_each_mergetag

methods.description: Verifies the signature of a commit.

methods.description: Records author date info for commits.

methods.description: Comparison function for commits by author date.

methods.description: Verifies signatures on commits during merge.
